input: Apply for a summer internship at a local nonprofit

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the user already has a specific nonprofit in mind versus needing to research and identify candidates changes the entire first phase of the plan.
The user's field of study, background, or area of interest determines which nonprofits to target and how to frame their application.
Application deadlines and the desired start date are hard limits that dictate urgency and sequencing of every step.
Knowing which application materials the user already has ready (resume, cover letter, references) versus what still needs to be created shapes the immediate next actions.
Whether the internship must be in-person, remote, or hybrid — and the geographic area meant by 'local' — affects which organizations are even eligible.
The user may prioritize certain causes (environment, education, health, etc.), which narrows the nonprofit search and helps tailor application materials.
Understanding whether the user wants paid work, academic credit, skill-building, or networking clarifies what a successful outcome looks like and helps rank opportunities.

gold.taskTitle: Apply for a Summer Internship at a Local Nonprofit
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply for a summer internship at a local nonprofit organization.

questions.title: Do you have a specific nonprofit already in mind?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with researching organizations or jumps straight to preparing application materials.

questions.title: What field or type of work are you hoping to do?
questions.description: Identifies the user's background or area of interest so the right nonprofits and roles can be targeted.

questions.title: When is your target application deadline or start date?

questions.title: Which application materials do you already have ready?
questions.description: Finds out what the user still needs to create — resume, cover letter, references — so the plan focuses on gaps.

questions.title: Must the internship be in-person, or is remote acceptable?
questions.description: Determines the geographic and format requirements that filter which nonprofits qualify as candidates.

questions.title: Is there a specific cause or mission you care most about?
questions.description: Reveals the user's values and cause preferences to narrow the nonprofit search and personalize application materials.

questions.title: Are you prioritizing pay, academic credit, or skill-building?
questions.description: Clarifies what a successful internship outcome looks like so opportunities can be ranked and the application framed accordingly.
